blocks.text:
Breakfast and free time in Lima. Before your transfer to the airport, we suggest a visit to the Larco Museum (optional, see Optional excursions). Transfer to the airport and departure.

The Larco Herrera Museum was founded in the early 20th century and occupies an 18th-century colonial mansion that was once home to a Viceroy of Peru. Its collection includes ceramics, textiles, jewellery, gold, mummies and a well-known collection of pottery with erotic subjects. More than 45,000 objects represent the Inca, Moche, Nazca and Chimú cultures.

Optional visit: $65 per person. The museum also has a restaurant serving Peruvian cuisine, Café del Museo.

blocks.text: Fourteen days through the many faces of Peru: Lima and its colonial centre, Cusco and Machu Picchu, the Sacred Valley, the Altiplano and Lake Titicaca, the condors of the Colca Canyon, Arequipa, the White City, an optional flight over the Nazca Lines, and the north, with Chan Chan, the Temples of the Sun and the Moon and the treasures of the Lord of Sipán.
